svg.aria-label: ADR-009: the licence gate, a component enters only under the Apache, MIT or BSD licences with no condition added; every entry keeps the source text of its address sealed beside the content; English first, multilinguality later as new rows; the dossier names the languages of the training data; the doors closed
svg.title: ADR-009 — Components and their licences, the source text of every address, English first, the dossier
svg.text: No licence risk at all, the source text of every address kept, English first, the languages named
quantum-cortex, original figure for ADR-009. Two principles frame the four decisions: no licence risk at all, and no added complexity; the doors are closed.
Decision B1: no dependency that could become paid, and no licence risk at all
a candidate component
a model, an encoder, an engine,
a library on the critical path
the gate: the licence, as read
Apache, MIT or BSD, with no condition
added; in doubt, it does not enter
enters, listed with its licence as read
weights pinned by revision and copied locally
excluded; a useful idea rewritten entirely
a sub licence, terms of use, a field or revenue limit

g.text: no component whose licence could one day impose a payment as the project grows, or that could not be removed once integrated;
excluded too: a share alike clause on code, a licence that must be read twice; a fine tuned model inherits its base's licence;
a standard open execution engine without proprietary extension; the organ never depends on an encoder it cannot recompute;
an outside model may serve as an instrument of measurement without becoming a component, its licence read in full first,
and not clean, not measured either; an outside reader, if ever, through the text contract only, two readers passing the protocol first

svg.text: Decision B2: keep the source text of every address
the entry: cue (the hash address) · pointer (the content hash) ·
salience · schema · times · state · source pointer, a second pointer
to the text the address was computed from, a sealed payload of its own

g.text: same cipher, same key, same scope as the content; the entry stays
under the size law; the hash address stays, language free, valid for
identifiers; the day a learned encoder is added, the index is
recomputed from the sealed texts and no journal is migrated;
older journals declare the text absent, nothing recoded in silence;
summaries and sentinels carry none, by construction (confirmed);
at eviction the source text is released with the content; the phase event says so

svg.text: Decision B3: English first, multilinguality later

g.text: research continues in English only, the protocol, the model, the data: one variable at a time;
multilinguality comes later as new rows, with its own fact generator and its own configuration hash
a semantic encoder is planned as hybrid addressing, the hash for identifiers and the encoder for meaning
and language; not integrated now; four consequences settled before it enters: the exact address kept
beside it; the size law; the write gate under semantic addresses, the revision mechanism first;
security, the system level zero measured again and the veto's threshold recalibrated language by language
the encoder settles the language for finding a note, not for reading it: the reader must understand the line

svg.text: Decision B4: the compute dossier names the languages of the training data

g.text: the one thing costly to change afterwards is stated explicitly; the choice is the founder's and is pending:
English only, simpler, in the continuity of the current model, other languages by a second pass;
or a share of French and Dutch from the start, useful locally, each language taking capacity at small size
the linked question, his as well: train from zero, full control of the data, a model built end to end in Europe;
or fine tune an open base under a permissive licence, which belongs to the project with its origin kept
the dossier is prepared with both options; the size study of the external arm is what sizes the request
bytes need no vocabulary extension for a new language

svg.text: The doors closed, by the principle of no added complexity
a large model out of reach of the project's machines; an outside training recipe (its hardest negative control enters the wider control already named, as a variant);
long context as a comparator of the organ; any model reachable only as an online service; a second frame for the external arm. Not declared; the direction fixed is finished coherently.

g.text: a candidate; one variable at a time
the gate
what enters and what is kept
what is excluded or closed
